def shapes_of(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):

                seen.add((i,j))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
